def save(res,name):
 global obs

 res.save(str(root/name))
 (root/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps({'dir':name,'meta':res.meta}),flush=True)
def observe(name='obs'):
 save(r.get_obs(depth=True),name)
def move(pose,grip=0,name='move',rows=1):
 save(r.submit('ee_pose',[list(pose)+[grip]]*rows,video='none',depth=True),name)
def joint(q,grip=0,name='joint',duration=3):

 start=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]); target=np.array(q)
 n=int(duration*15)

 save(r.submit('joint_position',a,video='none',depth=True),name)
print('READY',flush=True)
while True:
 p=root/'command.py'
 if p.exists():
  code=p.read_text(); p.unlink()
  try:
   exec(compile(code,'command.py','exec'),globals())
  except Exception:
   traceback.print_exc()
  print('COMMAND_DONE',flush=True)
 time.sleep(.2)
